Applies to: Microsoft Teams
Symptoms: no sound, microphone not working, camera not detected, echo, others cannot hear me

# SOP-TMS-02 Teams sign-in loop or Teams will not start

Applies to: Microsoft Teams
Symptoms: teams keeps asking to sign in, blank white screen, teams crashes on start

Steps for the user:
1. Quit Teams completely from the system tray.
2. Clear the Teams cache: delete the contents of %appdata%\Microsoft\Teams (classic) or reset the new Teams app in Settings > Apps.
3. Start Teams and sign in with your work account.
4. If the problem continues, use Teams on the web (teams.microsoft.com) while the desktop app is checked.

Escalation: Escalate to Messaging & Collaboration Support if Teams on the web also fails.
response: Hi! Sorry to hear you're stuck in a sign-in loop on the Teams desktop app. Since the web version works, let's try clearing the Teams cache and signing out completely. Please close Teams, then navigate to %appdata%\Microsoft\Teams on your computer and delete the contents of the Cache folder. After that, restart Teams and try signing in again. This usually resolves sign-in loop issues. Let me know if you need further help!

3. Disconnect and reconnect the VPN, making sure to choose the nearest gateway.
4. Update your VPN client from the Company Portal to ensure you have the latest version.
5. Avoid large uploads or streaming while connected to the VPN as these can affect stability.
If your VPN connection continues to drop more than three times an hour despite a good home connection, please let us know so we can escalate the issue to Network & Remote Access for further assistance.

After making these checks and changes, please retry posting the invoice once. If the posting still fails, escalate to ERP Finance Support with the error message number for further assistance.

After freeing up space, try sending your email again. If you need assistance with this or if the problem persists, please let us know immediately so we can help you meet your tender deadline.

# SOP-EUC-01 Laptop is slow or the disk is full

Applies to: Windows laptop / endpoint
Symptoms: laptop slow, computer freezing, disk full, low storage

Steps for the user:
1. Restart the laptop; do not only close the lid.
2. Install pending updates from Settings > Windows Update and restart again.
3. Run Disk Cleanup and delete temporary files; move large personal files to OneDrive.
4. Close applications that start automatically and are not needed (Task Manager > Startup).

Escalation: Escalate to End-User Computing if the laptop is still slow after updates or the disk fails.
response:
To help with your disk full warning and slow laptop, please follow these steps:
1. Restart your laptop completely; do not just close the lid.
2. Install any pending updates by going to Settings > Windows Update, then restart your laptop again.
3. Run Disk Cleanup to delete temporary files and consider moving large personal files to OneDrive to free up space.
4. Close any unnecessary applications that start automatically by opening Task Manager and going to the Startup tab.
If your laptop remains slow or the disk issue persists after these steps, please let us know so we can escalate the issue to End-User Computing for further assistance.
